The factor by which the H2 yield from epoxy resin in molten KOH grows between 300 °C and 500 °C can be calculated as follows:

(114.2 mg/g) / (15.2 mg/g) = 7.5

Therefore, the H2 yield from epoxy resin in molten KOH grows by a factor of 7.5 between 300 °C and 500 °C.
